work_hours_ui.purpose: Show the Work Hours UI: navigation, overview/wakes/detail and legacy schedule routes, and the Organization Settings operating controls.
work_hours_ui.removal_condition: Remove once the Work Hours UI is accepted for release and the production profile enables it permanently.

kb_compose_ui.purpose: Show the Knowledge Compose entry action and its write-path dialog.
kb_compose_ui.removal_condition: Remove once KB compose is accepted for release or retired.

task_attributes_ui.purpose: Show Settings › Task attributes (custom task attribute definitions management: list, create/edit, detail with version history, archive) in the web Settings sub-navigation and the desktop Settings dialog.
task_attributes_ui.removal_condition: Remove once the Custom Task Attributes v1 UI is accepted for release and the production profile enables it permanently (PR9).
